card.name: Linking words mid-sentence before a clause
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, its, who, while, as, the, and attempt, placed in the middle of a sentence just before a descriptive phrase or clause. It is not tied to one topic.

modes.label: Prepositions and pronouns
modes.description: Words like of or its that join a noun to the phrase that follows.
modes.example: Social Anxiety Disorder resembles an extreme form<< of>> shyness.

modes.label: Conjunctions and relatives
modes.description: Words like while, as, who, or when that start a new clause.
modes.example: Women of childbearing age<< who>> are overweight or have a history of IH

modes.label: Partway through a medical word
modes.description: A middle piece of a long medical term.
modes.example: Exclude other potential causes of ILD/pne<<um>>onitis and permanently discontinue ZY
